note: Checked against Turtle WoW's trees, saved by /apg talents.

levelling.why: Feral. Cat form for damage, bear when it goes wrong: Ferocity, Sharpened Claws and Predatory Strikes, Feral Swiftness to get around, Heart of the Wild and Leader of the Pack by 40. Omen of Clarity at 51, then Furor.

specs.why: Moonkin Form, Vengeance, Nature's Grace and Eclipse, with Restoration's Genesis for your damage over time: the caster.
Cat and bear: Heart of the Wild, Berserk and Leader of the Pack, Omen of Clarity from Balance and Furor to shift for energy.
Swiftmend, Nature's Swiftness, Improved Regrowth and Tree of Life Form, with Balance's Omen of Clarity: the raid healer.

alts.name: Bear
alts.why: Bear form from 10. Ferocity, Thick Hide and Feral Instinct to tank, Sharpened Claws and Primal Fury for rage, Feral Charge at 28, Heart of the Wild by 39 and Leader of the Pack at 40; Balance's Omen of Clarity at 60.

levelling.why: Beast Mastery. Your pet does the tanking and much of the damage: Unleashed Fury, Ferocity and Frenzy for its damage, Bestial Wrath and Spirit Bond, and Kill Command at 40. Marksmanship's crits after.

specs.why: Bestial Wrath, Frenzy and Kill Command, with Marksmanship's crits: your pet does much of the damage, solo or in a group.
Mortal Shots, Experimental Ammunition and Lock and Load, with Beast Mastery's Swift Aspects and Unleashed Fury: the raid damage build.
Melee with Carve, Lacerate and Lightning Reflexes, traps with Untamed Trapper, and Beast Mastery's Swift Aspects and Coordinated Assault.

levelling.why: Frost. Improved Frostbolt, Frost Nova and Shatter let you freeze a mob and crit it down, Ice Block and Ice Barrier keep you alive, and Arcane Concentration's free casts save mana from 46.

specs.why: Arcane Missiles and Arcane Rupture, Presence of Mind and Arcane Power, with Frost Nova and slows to kite: burst for PvP.
Ignite, Hot Streak and Combustion, with Arcane's Clearcasting: raid damage where fire resistance allows.
Winter's Chill, Icicles and Flash Freeze, with Arcane's Clearcasting: steady raid damage.

levelling.why: Retribution with a two-hander. Benediction for mana, Conviction and Vengeance for crits, Seal of Command at 30 and Vengeful Strikes by 40; Divine Strength, then Protection's Precision to hit more often.

specs.why: Holy Shock, Illumination, Divine Favor and Daybreak, with Retribution's Blessing of Kings and Improved Blessings: the raid healer.
Holy Shield, Righteous Defense, Righteous Strikes and Bulwark of the Righteous, with Retribution's Deflection and Blessing of Kings: the tank.
Seal of Command, Vengeance and Vengeful Strikes with a two-hander, Blessing of Kings for the raid, and Holy's Divine Strength.

alts.name: Sword and Board
alts.why: Protection with a shield from 10. Redoubt and Shield Specialization block and give mana back, Holy Shield at 30 with Reckoning's extra attacks, Righteous Strikes and Bulwark of the Righteous at 41; then Holy's Divine Strength and Divine Intellect.

levelling.why: Shadow, with a wand. Wand Specialization and Spirit Tap keep your mana up between kills, Mind Flay and Shadow Weaving do the damage, Vampiric Embrace heals you, and Shadowform comes at 42.

specs.why: Smite and Holy Fire: Searing Light, Purifying Flames, Force of Will and Chastise, with Holy's Divine Fury and Spiritual Guidance.
Spiritual Healing, Spiritual Guidance and Ascendance, with Discipline's mana: the raid healer.
Shadowform with Shadow Weaving and Vampiric Embrace: damage, and a little healing for the group.

levelling.why: Combat. Lightning Reflexes and Deflection keep you standing, Precision and Dual Wield Specialization make both weapons hit, and Surprise Attack, Blade Rush and Adrenaline Rush follow by 40. Assassination's crits and Slice and Dice after.

specs.why: Seal Fate, Envenom and Noxious Assault: poisons from both weapons and combo points from crits.
Precision, Weapon Expertise, Blade Rush and Adrenaline Rush, Hack and Slash with swords or axes: the raid damage build.
Hemorrhage, Preparation and Mark for Death, with Honor Among Thieves and Tricks of the Trade for the group: control and burst for PvP.

levelling.why: Enhancement. Ancestral Knowledge, Thundering Strikes and Flurry, Stormstrike at 30, and Bloodlust at 41; Elemental's cheaper, harder shocks and Clearcasting from your melee crits follow.

specs.why: Call of Thunder, Lightning Mastery, Elemental Fury and Earthquake, with Restoration's Tidal Mastery and Water Shield: the caster.
Stormstrike, Elemental Weapons, Element's Grace and Bloodlust, with Elemental's Clearcasting from melee crits: melee for raids and PvP.
Chain Heal, Water Shield, Ancestral Swiftness and Spirit Link, with Enhancement's Stable Shields for more Water Shield charges: the raid healer.

levelling.why: Affliction, then Demonology. Instant Corruption, Siphon Life and Dark Harvest kill with damage over time while you drain your health back; from 41 your demon gets stronger and cheaper to summon.

specs.why: Malediction, Siphon Life and Dark Harvest, with Destruction's Bane and Devastation: damage over time for raids.
Soul Link and Master Demonologist: a strong demon and a hard warlock to kill.
Ruin, Emberstorm and Conflagrate, with Demonic Sacrifice: fire and shadow burst for raids and PvP.

levelling.why: Arms, then Fury. Improved Rend and Deep Wounds bleed what you hit, Sweeping Strikes and Master of Arms speed up every kill, and Mortal Strike lands at 40. Fury's crit and rage talents follow.

specs.why: Mortal Strike with a two-hander and Master of Arms for your weapon: questing at 60, PvP, and dungeons before Fury gear.
Dual wield with Flurry and Bloodthirst: the raid damage build.
Shield Slam tank with Defiance and Concussion Blow: holds threat and lasts in dungeons and raids.

alts.name: Sword and Board
alts.why: Protection with a shield from 10. Shield Specialization gives rage on every block, Improved Revenge stuns, Last Stand at 25, Shield Slam at 30 and Concussion Blow at 40; then Arms' Tactical Mastery and Deep Wounds.
